question: Can a deterministic bracket-and-bisection scalar controller remove the projection-derived global-budget truncation and selectively actuate q_is on a capability-gated fresh lexicon?

novelty_search.nearest_null: The fixed-budget donor-free q_is actuator passed every A/C panel but missed v2 P by 0.023; 14/16 v2 P and 13/16 v3 P alphas hit a grid endpoint, while all five interior P solutions reflected at 1.002-1.003.
novelty_search.failed_control: A different P surface was native-incapable and opened no causal outcomes.
novelty_search.new_question: Replace the postulated global budget and 257-grid approximation with a deterministic continuity-based bracket/root algorithm, freeze it before a new lexicon, and test intended is/was edits plus unrelated C collateral.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: q_is and rank one remain frozen. This changes the causal controller algorithm and removes a demonstrated actuator truncation; it is not a rank, basis, or compression sweep.

fresh_authority.syntax: Unchanged v2/v3 At-this/that-moment A1, bulletin-embedded A2, present/previous temporal-paraphrase P, and canonical C.
fresh_authority.overlap_rule: No agent or row ID may overlap v1-v3.

frozen_design.direction: A/P use the requested opposite is/was answer. C alternates present-to-past and past-to-present by group parity, computes alpha only from fixed is/was rows, and scores the unrelated C answer/foil afterward.
frozen_design.initial_step: ||x||_2 / 1024. Evaluate both signs and retain the sign with the larger requested is/was margin; ties choose positive.
frozen_design.bracket: Starting at zero, double the signed step for exactly 24 rounds or until requested margin reaches the reflected target -m(0).
frozen_design.root: For bracketed rows, perform exactly 32 bisection rounds on the continuous signed interval and use the crossing endpoint. Unbracketed rows use the final explored endpoint and are reported unreachable.
frozen_design.capability_first: From the same two native capture forwards, all eight family-by-direction population cells must meet v2/v3's frozen thresholds before any root/head intervention evaluation. Otherwise terminate invalid with causal_outcomes_opened=false.

predictions.pred_a_fresh_authority_capability_and_ex: Rows are deterministic/disjoint, all eight frozen capability cells pass, and exact final-head replay <=1e-3 before causal outcomes open.
predictions.pred_b_donor_free_root_controller: Every alpha uses only source state, direction, fixed is/was rows, and the frozen 24+32 algorithm; all A/P rows bracket and finish within 1e-4 margin-reflection error.
predictions.pred_c_fresh_A_actuation: A1 and A2 mean recovery each >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_fresh_P_generalization: P mean margin reflection >=0.95 with direction fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_e_unrelated_C_selectivity: C normalized unrelated movement <=0.20 despite receiving the alternating intended is/was edit.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 2 model forwards/128 examples and 64 intervention records, <=3,776 selected-head root evaluations, zero fit/transformer backward/model update, and no grid points.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: identify a prospectively validated donor-free scalar q_is actuator and license upstream local-reader fitting.
terminal.null: Valid root controller misses fresh A/P or C selectivity; retain projected q_is only and do not raise rank.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, head, controller identity, root coverage, or price fails.
